messages:
Sam (eng-platform): heads-up: noticed p95 jumping on the endpoint breakdown while p99 stayed flat for the api->text route. Screenshot: https://console.redwood.internal/d/latency/zzzz :confused:
Rina (console): can you paste the chart's metadata? aggregation mode, sample counts?
Sam (eng-platform): aggregation=auto (ui picks), total_samples=3200, window=10m. p95 spikes at 11:07, p99 unchanged.
Eli (backend): did we recently change routing for burst handling? small fallback pools can shift mid-percentiles without affecting heavy tail.
Marta (observability): also check if the UI switched from tdigest to histogram interpolation mid-window. That can make p95 appear to jump if buckets align awkwardly.
Sam (eng-platform): quick debug: found a batch of ~150 fallback-tagged requests at 11:06 with latency around 200ms. They sit between p50 and p95 for main pool.
Rina (console): ok. immediate UX fix: add an "aggregation mode" chip and show per-quantile sample counts in tooltip; add a low-sample warning when sample_count < 1000. I'll open a small patch.
Eli (backend): ingest fix: ensure route_variant is attached to sketches before we persist/merge. Right now the client sometimes emits sketches without variant tags. I'll patch the emitter to include route_variant=primary|fallback.
Marta (observability): telemetry: emit an event when aggregation mode flips within a single chart window, and tag timeseries with fragment_count so we can alert when many tiny sketches are merged.
Sam (eng-platform): could we also show a small warning badge when different variants are visible in the aggregated series? maybe "mixed variants: results may reflect merged distributions"
Rina (console): good idea. I'll add a subtle badge and link to docs explaining how merged distributions affect percentiles.
Eli (backend): deploying variant-tagging now. Also adding a server-side merge path that prefers rehydrated raw samples when total N>2k to avoid mid-tail wobble.
deploy-bot: build passed 12: staging deploy queued for rina/agg-mode-pill PR #4210.
Marta (observability): I'll run a small sim to quantify how many fallback samples are required to move p95 by 200ms at different N. Will post numbers in thread. :bar_chart:
Sam (eng-platform): thanks all. Once staging is up let's re-check same time window and confirm the pill + tooltip mitigate confusion for support tickets.
